warnings.instruction: Be aware of the debris carried by the wind. Local disturbances in outdoor activities are possible due to debris carried by the wind.
warnings.sender: Republic Hydrometeorological Service of the Republic of Srpska

warnings.headline: Low-temperature Yellow Warning for Bosnia and Herzegovina - region Banja Luka
warnings.description: Tmin between -4°C  and -7°C , in the mountains region in the south up to -10°C.
warnings.instruction: Be aware that low air temperatures are expected. There are possible health risks among the vulnerable population, for example, the elderly and very young people and the homeless.
warnings.sender: Republic Hydrometeorological Service of the Republic of Srpska

warnings.headline: Moderate Low temperature Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / North-East
warnings.description: Low temperatures may affect the health of sensitive members of the population.
warnings.instruction:
Warm and dry clothes and footwear are recommended.
Use rich creams for your face and exposed body parts.

warnings.headline: Yellow Hard frost warning for Poland - Malopolskie Province Nowotarski County
warnings.description: It is forecasted the minimum temperature at night in some places from -17°C to -15°C. The maximum temperature at day from -6°C to -2°C. The mean wind speed from 10 km/h to 20  km/h.
warnings.instruction: BE AWARE that low temperatures are expected. Some health risks amongst vulnerable people e.g. the elderly, very young and homeless are possible.
